text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No results after coming this far… How should we judge this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Were the fundamentals of my hypothesis off the mark? Or could it be…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Were the fundamentals of my hypothesis off the mark? Or could it be…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now… You're just stating the obvious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't it more apt to suggest I rethink my approach?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You should prepare yourself. Things are about to get even busier!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We'll need to review the data we have before we continue our research!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was merely thinking I need to come up with a new hypothesis, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Being depressed does nothing for productivity. I have no time for it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Everything is a source of encouragement. I'll show you in the next race!
